contract.title: 4-bit accumulator
contract.description: Build a 4-bit accumulator. Levers IN0..IN3 set an addend (bit 0 = least significant); CLK is the clock lever. Every time CLK is switched ON (rising edge) the register is increased by IN: ACC := (ACC + IN) mod 2^4; the lamps ACC3 .. ACC0 show the register as a binary number. Switching CLK off changes nothing. The register is 0 at the start (all lamps dark). The value of IN present just before the rising edge is the one that is added (IN is never changed within 100 ticks before an edge). Library hint (component tier only): a full-adder cell, a D flip-flop (captures D on the rising edge of CLK) and a signal crossover are available.
